description: This file contains helper functions and setup procedures for testing bitmap functionality within a Git repository. It includes functions to compare traversal outputs, set up complex repository histories, verify object existence, and perform various tests related to bitmap indexing, pack files, and revisions.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares traversal output files, ensuring bitmap output matches expectations while accounting for subtle differences.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a complex repository history with multiple branches, merges, and bitmaps to test various scenarios.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs a series of 'git rev-list' commands with bitmap options to verify commit counting, enumeration, and object listing.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs 'rev_list_tests_head' over specified branch names to validate revision listing.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Performs various bitmap-related tests, including verification of rev-list outputs and cloning behavior.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks if a given object is stored as a delta on a specified base object.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines the pack source of a specific object in the repository.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a reverse index for a given revision.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Creates a multi-pack index with bitmaps, performs tests on revision existence, pack creation, delta relationships, and cloning behavior related to bitmaps.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Sets up partial bitmap tests with a simplified repository state to verify partial bitmap functionality.
